market_summary: Market exhibits strong directional moves across assets during the New York Session, but key benchmarks are reaching extreme ATR levels and structural session highs/lows. Gold and FX remain in firm downtrends below VWAP/EMA50, while US100 and BTC display strong bullish extensions above VWAP. However, entries at current market prices present unfavorable risk-reward due to extended ATR positions, GEX Call/Put wall proximity, and volume/CVD momentum exhaustion. All instruments are set to HOLD awaiting pullbacks or structural retests.

signals.rationale: Price is well below VAL (4028.54) and POC (4043.68), expanding downward. CVD is -2.84 (BEARISH) with negative slope (-0.44), confirming strong selling pressure in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price trades below both VWAP (4035.42) and EMA50 (4024.31), hugging the lower ATR band (3994.69). Recent high-volume breakdown confirms momentum. GEX regime is NEGATIVE_AMPLIFYING below Gamma Flip (3995.47), accelerating downside toward next targets, though near local Session Low (3987.10). A brief consolidation near Session Low suggests waiting for pullback or entry setup.

Price is inside VA (VAL 1.10824, VAH 1.11472) but well below POC (1.10920). CVD is -14,950 (BEARISH) with strong negative slope (-305.81) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is firmly below VWAP (1.11257) and EMA50 (1.11170), hovering near lower ATR band (1.10876). While trend is strongly bearish, price is currently testing the major support at Session Low (1.10824) without immediate volume expansion spike on the latest bar, indicating high risk of low-volume sweep/rebound inside VA.

Price resides inside VA (VAL 1.32661, VAH 1.33233), below POC (1.32813). CVD is -2,117 (NEUTRAL) with positive short-term slope (+241.14), indicating fading downside momentum in NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (1.33068) and EMA50 (1.33002), hovering near lower ATR band (1.32706). Low RVOL (0.17) and flat consolidation right above Session Low support (1.32661) warrant holding for clear direction or structural rejection.

Price is trading well above VAH (28341.44) and POC (28265.85) in price expansion mode. CVD is +15.02 (BULLISH) with positive slope (+1.94) during NEW_YORK_SESSION. Price is strongly above VWAP (28200.91) and EMA50 (28301.06), pressing against the upper ATR band (28559.48). GEX regime is POSITIVE_DAMPENING with Gamma Flip at 28342.84, but price has pushed past Call Wall #1 (28553.42) into Session High (28593.41). Per US100 volume caveat, lack of yellow RVOL is typical. However, buying right at the extreme Session High into positive gamma dampening presents suboptimal R:R.

Price trades above VAH (73998.28) and POC (73660.42). Price is well above VWAP (73777.10) and EMA50 (73931.36) following a strong bullish breakout. However, CVD is -0.07 (BEARISH) showing clear divergence from price action in NEW_YORK_SESSION. RVOL is low (0.58) with 0 volume spikes. Price rejected near Session High (74706.20) and upper ATR band (74676.25), forming upper wicks. CVD divergence and lack of volume expansion at highs suggest temporary exhaustion/hold.
